title: AgentProof configuration
description: Configuration for AgentProof, the local QA gate for AI-generated code and agent PRs.

pathPattern.description: Relative path, path fragment, or wildcard-style pattern.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete.

profile.description: Risk profile used to derive default thresholds and severity budgets.

design.description: DesignGuard configuration for rendered UI and product-design readiness checks.

type.description: Product type used to select contextual design rules.

url.description: Local or CI URL to render for DOM/CSS/screenshot proof.

locale.description: Browser locale and Accept-Language used for rendered audits and browser-clone capture, for example fr-FR.

routes.description: Routes audited when url is provided.

viewports.description: Viewport set used for rendered design checks.

strictness.description: DesignGuard strictness. Defaults to the AgentProof profile when omitted.

failUnder.description: DesignGuard score threshold. Defaults are relaxed 70, standard 80, strict 85.

ai.description: Optional AI design-review layer. Local deterministic checks remain the source of truth.

blocking.description: When true, AI reviewer findings can be medium severity instead of informational.

provider.description: AI provider for DesignGuard. openai-api uses OPENAI_API_KEY; codex-auth uses the local Codex login at CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex/auth.json.

model.description: AI model used by --design-ai, DesignFix, and DesignImprove. For codex-auth, use a Codex backend model such as gpt-5.5 or gpt-5.3-codex-spark when available.

reasoning.description: Optional reasoning effort for supported AI models, for example xhigh with gpt-5.5.

failUnder.description: Score threshold below which AgentProof exits non-zero. Overrides profile default when set.

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file. Known findings in the baseline are excluded from the active score.

history.description: Suggested JSONL history path for CI or local scripts. CLI --history controls writes.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of text files scanned by static checks.

ignore.description: Path fragments or names ignored by file scanning. AgentProof also applies its built-in ignores.

slopPhrases.description: Additional phrases treated as generic or unfinished AI output. Built-in phrases still apply.

packages.description: Monorepo package directories or simple workspace patterns such as packages/* and apps/*.

commands.description: Custom verification commands run before auto-detected commands.

name.description: Stable command id fragment used in findings.

label.description: Human-readable command label shown in reports.

command.description: Shell command run from the project root.

severity.description: Finding severity if the command fails.

language.description: Optional stack metadata, for example javascript, python, go, rust, custom.

optional.description: When true, command failures are reported as informational instead of blocking.

budgets.description: Maximum active findings allowed by severity before AgentProof creates a policy finding.

severityOverrides.description: Map rule ids to overridden severities.

suppressions.description: Documented suppressions for known false positives. Prefer narrow, temporary suppressions.

id.description: Rule id or wildcard pattern, for example slop.*.

category.description: Finding category, for example security, ui, slop, claims, policy.

expires.description: Date after which the suppression no longer applies.
